title: Classified Communications Network at the National Security Agency Goes Down, Defense Official Says
description: The National Security Agency (NSA) experienced a temporary outage of its classified internal network, NSANet, due to scheduled routine maintenance. The disruption affected some internal systems but did not impact mission-critical capabilities or the agency's ability to defend national security. The NSA emphasized its infrastructure has multiple redundancy layers to maintain operations during maintenance or unexpected events. Officials stated there is no evidence linking this outage or other recent government and private sector disruptions to cyberattacks or hostile activity. The outages are attributed to simultaneous system upgrades and patching efforts across various organizations.
